title: Computer
body:
"Applies math equations to the two inputted signals. Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, Division, and Exponentiation."

The Computer is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It performs basic arithmetic on incoming signals like the boring subject in school.

Functionality

The Computer accepts two separate inputs, performs math on them according to its setting, and outputs them. The left input is treated as the left number while the right input is treated as the right number. Interacting with the Computer causes it to cycle through the following settings: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and exponentiation.

There are two things to note about the Calculator:

  • There are no negative signals, and attempting to output a negative number will cause the Computer to not emit a signal.
  • If a Calculator set to division mode would attempt to divide by zero, then it will not emit a signal.
